identification: About 28 old bottles in three groups: 8 aqua/clear embossed crown-seal soft drink bottles (at least one clearly PHILLIPS & SON, P&S shield, DEVONPORT; others faint), 13 'old Tas bottles' in a foam box (handwritten card: Abbotts, Jones & Co, Port Huon Fruit Juices, Cascade, Tasma, Bakers Milk; several amber, one milk bottle, one painted-label pyro), and 7 'old Aust bottles' (card: Chas Ogg & Co Melbourne, Champions Vinegar, Golden Circle, Mildara, John Sutherland & Son; amber beer-type bottles, clear sauce/vinegar bottles, one squat jar). All 20th century crown seal and later; no Codd, blob-top or stoneware seen.
